queries.name: grand_totals_full_business_and_comparable
queries.purpose: Show the headline totals for the comparable branches and the current-only contribution from the new branch.
queries.intent: Return one row with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] for the like-for-like branches only by applying the branch filter to all four required tables: 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] with values CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021. Also return a separate one-row result for CFH022 only with [net revenue CURRENT], [net qty CURRENT], and [net bills CURRENT], filtered on those same four branch columns to CFH022, so new-branch current contribution can be reported separately and not as growth.

queries.name: latest_month_store_summary
queries.purpose: Show which like-for-like branches drove the latest monthly result.
queries.intent: Find the latest available month in 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 after filtering all four branch tables 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. For that single month, group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Limit to 15 rows and sort by [net revenue CURRENT] descending.

queries.name: latest_month_division_breakdown
queries.purpose: Identify the main division-level contributors within the latest comparable month.
queries.intent: Find the latest available month in 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 after filtering all four branch tables 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. For that month, group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return the top 15 rows sorted by ABS([revenue Growth]) descending.

queries.name: latest_month_category_movers
queries.purpose: Surface the biggest category gains and declines in the latest comparable month.
queries.intent: Find the latest available month in 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] within the comparable branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 after filtering all four branch tables 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]. For that month, group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Return a paired tails set made from the top 7 rows by [revenue Growth] descending and the top 7 rows by [revenue Growth] ascending, with final sort by [revenue Growth] descending.

queries.name: monthly_trend_recent_months
queries.purpose: Provide the recent monthly trend so the summary can lead with the most recent period and place it in context.
queries.intent: Group by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] and return [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH] for the comparable branches only, applying the branch filter to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] with values CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021. Limit to the 12 most recent month rows and sort by 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] descending.

queries.name: category_decline_and_revenue_share
queries.purpose: Measure how many categories are declining and whether those categories represent a growing or shrinking share of revenue.
queries.intent: Return one row for the comparable branches only, with the branch filter applied to 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no], 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no], 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no], and 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] using CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021. Compute [COUNT], [COUNT_TOTAL], [COUNT %], [sum deg cur rev], [sum deg past rev], [sum total cur rev], [sum total past rev], [contribution cur], and [contribution past] from CAT_TABLE with no grouping so the report can state both the share of categories declining and the current versus past revenue share covered by those categories.

queries.name: latest_daily_transactions_branch
queries.purpose: Add current-period branch transaction context from the daily table without using it for year-on-year comparison.
queries.intent: Using 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt', first determine the latest date at or before 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[max_date] that has nonblank values in 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]. For that latest valid date, group by 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE] and compute true branch Transactions by taking the daily branch-level value once per date, not by summing repeated rows, using the level-specific column 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]. Return up to 15 rows sorted by the computed Transactions descending. Do not include any last-year comparison because this table has current-year data only.
